summary: Iter-30 Group A foundation (AppSumo launch) — full coverage pass: lastLoginAt stamping on every auth path, tier_config.py data integrity, /api/admin/usage shape/sort/filter/validation/aggregation, and the amber What's-New dot on the footer version pill. 23/23 backend pytest cases PASSED, 5/5 frontend Playwright cases PASSED, 3/3 regression routes load cleanly with no compile overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: tier_config.py is clean, frozen dataclasses, no DB writes at import — matches the Group-A 'pure data' constraint.
_stamp_last_login() is correctly wrapped in try/except so a Mongo write failure cannot block sign-in. Verified by code review (DB-failure monkeypatch path skipped per request).
/api/admin/usage uses re.escape on the q substring (good — prevents regex injection via search box), and bounds limit to 2000 (good — prevents response blowup).
Minor: sort_by regex allows 'scripts_total'/'renders_total' as valid values but the sort_key_map handles them correctly; spec docstring on the endpoint could be expanded but functionality is sound.
Footer.jsx uses string compare on lastSeen !== APP_VERSION (not semver) — this is intentional and acceptable since any change in the stored value triggers re-show; verified with old-version test.
test_credentials: DEV_BYPASS admin drcharitycampbell@gmail.com (passwordless). Non-admin test users seeded as test_iter30_*@example.com and auto-deleted via cleanup fixture.
seed_data_creation: All seeded buyers/scripts/renders use email prefix 'test_iter30_' and are purged by a per-test cleanup fixture that runs db.buyers/db.scripts/db.renders delete_many on that prefix. No real-buyer pollution. Verified prod DB untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Group A foundation is fully verified — Group B (render-endpoint quota gating + cost kill-switch breaker + cycle-reset cron) and Group C (Usage admin UI tab) are NOT in this iteration. When Group B/C ship, extend /app/backend/tests/test_iter30_group_a_foundation.py or create a new iter file; the cleanup fixture pattern (TEST_PREFIX='test_iter30_') is reusable. The admin auth flow is DEV_BYPASS in preview — production uses the same paths via STUDIO_GRANT_EMAILS + db.buyers, and all three paths are now telemetry-stamped (verified).
